block-guide:
CORE/SITE-TITLE (Site Title) Draws the site's name (Settings > General), linked to the home page by default. The text is the setting, never written in the block: change it with update-site-settings {siteTitle}, and every site-title on the site changes. Places: a header or footer global block, or a template frame. MARKUP (comment only; no HTML) level: DEFAULT 1 (an H1). 0 draws a

: use 0 in a header, as Twenty Twenty-Five does, so the page title (core/post-title level 1) stays the page's only H1. isLink (default true) links to the home page; linkTarget "_blank" opens a new tab. OUTPUT

Name

PITFALLS - The default level 1 in a header gives every page two H1s. - An empty site title draws nothing. - For a logo next to the name, put core/site-logo and core/site-title in a flex group. CHECK Open any page: the name appears in the header and links home; the page has one H1.
